Test, 30 points. Walk the room silently; give no hints.
Q1 (3). A fruit bowl has 9 plums and 6 peaches. (a) Write the ratio of plums to peaches with a colon and with the word to. 9:6 and 9 to 6 (1). (b) Write the ratio of peaches to all the fruit in simplest form. 6 to 15 = 2 to 5 (2).

Q3 (4). Maya and Leo share 45 stickers in the ratio 4 to 5, Maya to Leo. (a) Draw a tape diagram. Maya 4 equal boxes, Leo 5 equal boxes, 9 in all (1). (b) How many stickers in each box? 45 ÷ 9 = 5 (1). (c) How many stickers does each get? Maya 20 (1), Leo 25 (1).

(c) How many bottles does the machine fill in 15 minutes? 90 bottles (1).
Q5 (3). A bus travels at 40 miles per hour. (a) How far does it go in 6 hours? 240 miles (1). (b) How long does it take to go 280 miles? 280 ÷ 40 = 7 hours (2: 1 for the operation, 1 for the answer with units).

Q7 (4). (a) Find 30% of 90 students. 10% is 9, so 30% is 27 students (2). (b) 18 is 25% of a number. Find the number. 25% is 18, so 100% is 72 (2).

Test, 30 points. Walk the room silently; give no hints.
Q1 (3). A crate holds 4 plums and 12 peaches. (a) Write the ratio of plums to peaches with a colon and with the word to. 4:12 and 4 to 12 (1). (b) Write the ratio of peaches to all the fruit, then write it in simplest form. 12 to 16 (1), 3 to 4 (1).
Q2 (4). Fruit punch uses 5 cups of juice for every 6 cups of sparkling water. (a) Complete the ratio table. Juice: 5, 10, ?, 35. Water: 6, ?, 30, ?. Answers: water 12 (1), juice 25 (1), water 42 (1). (b) How many cups of juice go with 54 cups of sparkling water? 45 cups (1).
Q3 (4). Maya and Leo share 45 stickers in the ratio 4 to 5, Maya to Leo. (a) Draw a tape diagram. Maya 4 equal boxes, Leo 5 equal boxes, 9 in all (1). (b) How many stickers in each box? 45 ÷ 9 = 5 (1). (c) How many stickers does each get? Maya 20 (1), Leo 25 (1).
Q4 (5). (a) A machine fills 54 bottles in 9 minutes. Find the unit rate. 6 bottles per minute (1). (b) How many bottles does the machine fill in 15 minutes? 90 bottles (1). (c) Shop P sells 5 notebooks for $9. Shop Q sells 8 notebooks for $13.60. Find each unit price and say which is the better buy. P: $1.80 per notebook (1). Q: $1.70 per notebook (1). Q is the better buy because its unit price is lower (1).
Q5 (3). A bus travels at 40 miles per hour. (a) How far does it go in 6 hours? 240 miles (1). (b) How long does it take to go 280 miles? 280 ÷ 40 = 7 hours (2: 1 for the operation, 1 for the answer with units).
Q6 (4). (a) 36 squares of a 100-grid are shaded. Write this as a percent and as a fraction in simplest form. 36% (1), 9/25 (1). (b) Write 85% as a fraction in simplest form and as a decimal. 17/20 (1), 0.85 (1).
Q7 (4). (a) Find 30% of 90 students. 10% is 9, so 30% is 27 students (2: 1 for the method, 1 for the answer). (b) 18 is 25% of a number. Find the number. 25% is 18, so 100% is 4 × 18 = 72 (2: 1 for the method, 1 for the answer).
Q8 (3). Sam says, ‘12% of 50 is 12, because 12% of 100 is 12.’ Explain the mistake and find the correct answer. The whole is 50, not 100 (1). 50 is half of 100, so halve the 12 (1). 12% of 50 is 6 (1).
Give full credit for any correct method, such as a table or a diagram. Simplest form is required only in Q1(b) and Q6.
